svg.title: RocketMQ-Rust architecture
svg.desc: Producers send to broker clusters and consumers receive from them; both look routes up in the NameServer cluster, where every Broker registers and sends heartbeats. gRPC clients enter through the Proxy, which runs in cluster mode or embeds a Broker in local mode. Each broker name is a master and a replica with synchronous or asynchronous HA replication, and an optional OpenRaft Controller cluster, standalone or embedded in the NameServer, elects a new master when one fails. Inside each Broker, rocketmq-store writes through a local engine by default, with optional RocksDB and tiered engines. Admin CLI, TUI, dashboards and MCP servers reach the cluster through rocketmq-admin-core and the client SDK, off the message path. Shared crates provide the model, protocol, transport, runtime, security, error, observability, filter and macro foundations. Where motion is allowed, a looping tour plays seven steps: register, route lookup, send, store and replicate, consume, fail over and operate.
svg.text: Logical topology; deployment counts are illustrative.
